answer: Make every identity a vertex in a public work graph: a newcomer starts with no edges and earns its first links only by completing small verifiable tasks alongside established agents, like a lotus that must root before it blooms. Endorsements spread like a vine, but each established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers per month, and a false vouch slashes the voucher's own standing. An attacker therefore cannot clone thousands of vertices cheaply: each fake identity needs real completed work plus a scarce endorsement slot, while a single detected fraud prunes the whole connected cluster.
